beats.say: A pregnant pro dancer is making history on Dancing with the Stars.
Witney Carson is four months pregnant, making her the show's first pregnant pro.
Amber Glenn and Ezra Frech are the first Olympic and Paralympic champions in one season.
The new records do not stop there.
Adele Zaikman has joined as the very first Israeli pro dancer on the series.
Who is your favourite couple on the dance floor?

sources: Wikipedia, Dancing with the Stars (American TV series) season 35
facts: Witney Carson is the first pro to enter an installment of Dancing with the Stars while pregnant
Carson was four months pregnant with her third child at the time of the announcement
Amber Glenn and Ezra Frech became the first Olympic and Paralympic champions to compete during the same season
Adele Zaikman is the first Israeli professional dancer to be featured on the series
